title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasising on truthful and authentic information
body_text:
The Prime Minister,  Shri Narendra Modi today shared Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasising that the information that is disseminated should be truthful, authentic and in public interest, which empowers people and brings harmony.
The Prime Minister shared a Sanskrit verse-
“भद्रं कर्णेभिः शृणुयाम देवा भद्रं पश्येमाक्षभिर्यजत्राः।
स्थिरैरङ्गैस्तुष्टुवांसस्तनूभिर्व्यशेम देवहितं यदायुः॥”
The Prime Minister posted on X:
भद्रं कर्णेभिः शृणुयाम देवा भद्रं पश्येमाक्षभिर्यजत्राः।
स्थिरैरङ्गैस्तुष्टुवांसस्तनूभिर्व्यशेम देवहितं यदायुः॥”
भद्रं कर्णेभिः शृणुयाम देवा भद्रं पश्येमाक्षभिर्यजत्राः। स्थिरैरङ्गैस्तुष्टुवांसस्तनूभिर्व्यशेम देवहितं यदायुः॥ pic.twitter.com/CRFY0V3KTM — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) August 10, 2026

enrichment.summary: The Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam (verse) on social media platform X on 10 August 2026, emphasising that information disseminated to the public should be truthful, authentic and in public interest. The verse, drawn from Vedic tradition, speaks of hearing and seeing auspicious things and living a life devoted to the welfare ordained by the gods.
enrichment.context: This is a routine ceremonial/social-media communication from the Prime Minister's Office, part of a recurring practice where the Prime Minister shares quotes, verses, or thoughts from Indian scriptures and classical literature to convey messages relevant to contemporary issues such as media responsibility, misinformation, and public discourse. Such posts are common and do not represent a policy announcement, scheme, or governance decision.
